atlas.screen.title: Atlas
atlas.screen.memory: Map data in memory: %s MB of %s MB
atlas.map.title: Atlas map
atlas.tab.minimap.tooltip: The minimap, what it shows and the radar
atlas.tab.map.tooltip: Colors, shading, caves and server rules
atlas.tab.waypoints.tooltip: Waypoints in the world, deaths and temporary ones
atlas.option.minimapEnabled.tooltip: Show the minimap on the HUD
atlas.option.minimapRotate.tooltip: Turn the map so forward is always up. Off keeps north up
atlas.option.minimapTilt.tooltip: Draw the minimap as tilted 3D terrain
atlas.option.minimapZoom.tooltip: Screen pixels per block on the minimap
atlas.option.minimapCorner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in
atlas.option.minimapOffsetX.tooltip: Distance from the side of the screen
atlas.option.minimapOffsetY.tooltip: Distance from the top or bottom of the screen
atlas.option.minimapCoords.tooltip: Show your position under the minimap
atlas.option.minimapBiome.tooltip: Show the biome you are in
atlas.option.minimapLight.tooltip: Show block and sky light where you stand
atlas.option.minimapCompass.tooltip: Show N, E, S and W on the edge
atlas.option.minimapWaypoints.tooltip: Show waypoints on the minimap, pinned to the edge when far away
atlas.option.minimapHideInScreens.toolti: Hide the minimap while a screen is open
atlas.option.radarPlayers.tooltip: Mark other players on the minimap
atlas.option.radarHostile.tooltip: Mark hostile mobs on the minimap
atlas.option.radarPassive.tooltip: Mark animals and other passive mobs on the minimap
atlas.option.radarHideSneaking.tooltip: Leave sneaking players off the radar
atlas.option.radarHideInvisible.tooltip: Leave invisible players and mobs off the radar
atlas.option.colorMode.tooltip: Average block textures, or the colors vanilla maps use
atlas.option.heightShading.tooltip: Shade slopes and brighten high ground
atlas.option.shadingStrength.tooltip: How strong the height shading is
atlas.option.waterDepth.tooltip: Let the sea floor show through shallow water
atlas.option.biomeTint.tooltip: Color grass, leaves and water by biome
atlas.option.caveMode.tooltip: Slice the map at your height. Auto turns on underground and in the Nether
atlas.option.mapGrid.tooltip: Draw chunk borders on the fullscreen map
atlas.option.mapSmoothZoom.tooltip: Glide between zoom levels on the fullscreen map
atlas.option.mapGpu.tooltip: Keep the flat fullscreen map in textures on the graphics card, so it is sharp at any display size and moves at the full frame rate. Turn off to draw every frame on the processor
atlas.option.mapWaypointList.tooltip: Open the fullscreen map with the waypoint list showing
atlas.option.teleport.tooltip: Add Teleport to the map's right click menu. Only works when the server lets you run the command
atlas.option.teleportCommand.tooltip: The command that is sent. {x} {y} {z} are filled in
atlas.option.honorServerRules.tooltip: Turn off cave mode, the radar or the minimap when a server asks map mods to
atlas.option.terrainQuality.tooltip: Resolution of the 3D view. Lower is faster
atlas.option.terrainFov.tooltip: Field of view of the 3D camera
atlas.option.terrainFog.tooltip: Fade far terrain into the sky
atlas.option.waypointNames.tooltip: Show every waypoint's name. When off, the name shows while you look at a waypoint
atlas.option.waypointDistance.tooltip: Show every waypoint's distance. When off, it shows while you look at a waypoint
atlas.option.waypointBeams.tooltip: Draw a light beam at each waypoint
atlas.option.waypointMaxDistance.tooltip: Waypoints fade out past this distance
atlas.option.waypointScale.tooltip: Size of waypoint icons and labels in the world
atlas.option.waypointOcclusion.tooltip: What to do with waypoints hidden behind terrain
atlas.option.deathWaypoints.tooltip: Add a waypoint where you die
atlas.option.deathExpiryHours.tooltip: Remove death waypoints after this long
atlas.option.temporaryRemoveOnArrival.to: Remove a temporary waypoint when you reach it
atlas.option.temporaryExpiryMinutes.tool: Remove temporary waypoints after this long
atlas.option.memoryLimitMb.tooltip: How much map data stays in memory before old regions are unloaded
atlas.option.workerThreads.tooltip: Background threads for scanning and drawing. Needs a restart
atlas.option.scanRadius.tooltip: How many chunks around you are mapped. Auto follows render distance
atlas.option.saveIntervalSeconds.tooltip: How often explored regions are written to disk
atlas.option.subWorlds.tooltip: Keep a map and waypoints for each world behind one server address, like a lobby and a survival world. Applies the next time you join
atlas.option.world.tooltip: Which of the worlds on this address you are in. Step to another one if Atlas picked the wrong map, or past the last one to start a new map. Atlas remembers the answer
atlas.map.dimension.tooltip: Switch to the next explored dimension
atlas.map.cave.tooltip: Switch between the surface and a slice at a chosen height
atlas.map.cave.blocked: This server turned cave mode off
atlas.map.new.tooltip: New waypoint at the center of the map
atlas.map.import.tooltip: Import waypoints from a file or another map mod
atlas.map.export.tooltip: Write all waypoints of this world to a JSON file
atlas.map.flat.hint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, double click for a waypoint
atlas.map.terrain.hint: Drag to orbit, right drag to move, scroll to zoom
atlas.editor.name: Name
atlas.editor.temporary.tooltip: Removed when you reach it or when it expires
atlas.import.title: Import waypoints
atlas.import.none: Nothing to import. Put an Atlas JSON export in the atlas/import folder, or keep the waypoint folders of Xaero's Minimap, JourneyMap or VoxelMap in this game folder.
atlas.import.tooltip: Add these waypoints to this world
atlas.option.radarIdentify: Identify with the player list key
atlas.option.radarIdentify.tooltip: While the player list key (Tab) is held, the radar shows every entity and dropped item with its name
